title: Outstandingly Indulgent Malaysian Chestnut Curry
description: This dish features cooked chestnut, pickle, and a blend of Malaysian spices, making it a fresh and indulgent keto-friendly option.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the onion, garlic, and ginger, and saute until the onion is translucent.
Add the curry powder and cumin, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chestnuts, pickle, and 1 cup of water, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over cauliflower rice or keto-friendly noodles.
Refrigerate and consume within 1 week — this preparation is not shelf-stable without an approved acid level and canning process.

Refrigerator pickle only: store in the fridge and consume within 1 week. For shelf-stable canning, add at least 2 tablespoons of vinegar (5% acidity) per cup of brine and follow a tested water-bath process.
